# Error-diffusion dither

The organic dither of Floyd–Steinberg and of the classic Mac’s Atkinson, approximated on the GPU in 4×4 tiles: few colors, with the rounding error spread to neighboring pixels.

<EffectDemo effect="error-diffusion" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { errorDiffusion } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/error-diffusion';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(errorDiffusion({ preset: 'macintosh' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.method = 'floydSteinberg'`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling; parameters marked _structural_ recompile the pass that contains the effect.

## Parameters

| Parameter               | Type                           | Default            | Range    | Description                                                                   |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------ | ------------------ | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `method` _(structural)_ | 'floydSteinberg' \| 'atkinson' | `'floydSteinberg'` |          | Floyd–Steinberg keeps tones; Atkinson drops some error for punchier contrast. |
| `levels`                | number                         | `2`                | 2 – 8    | Levels per channel.                                                           |
| `monochrome`            | boolean                        | `true`             |          | Dither brightness only, in black and white.                                   |
| `pixelSize`             | number                         | `2`                | 1 – 8 px | Size of each dithered pixel.                                                  |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset      | Settings                             |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `macintosh` | `method: 'atkinson'`, `pixelSize: 2` |
| `newspaper` | `pixelSize: 1`                       |
| `color`     | `monochrome: false`, `levels: 3`     |
| `chunky`    | `pixelSize: 4`, `method: 'atkinson'` |

Apply one with `errorDiffusion({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Retro & display · tracked as story X7.8 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Cost:** 136.7 ms added to a 960×540 frame on CI container (SwiftShader software renderer) (2026-10-11). A software renderer: use it to compare effects, not to predict GPU times.
- **Size:** 7.4 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/error-diffusion`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: Floyd and Steinberg, An adaptive algorithm for spatial grey scale, 1976; Bill Atkinson’s dither (Apple MacPaint); Replayed per 4×4 tile in scanline order for the GPU.

## Related

- [Dither](./dither) — Reduces each channel to a few levels and hides the banding with a dither pattern: ordered Bayer matrices, void-and-cluster blue noise, or interleaved gradient noise.
- [Palette reduction](./palette) — Repaints the image with only the colors of a classic palette (Game Boy, CGA, EGA, PICO-8, Commodore 64, NES, or four of your own), matched by perceived difference, with optional dithering.
- [Bit crush](./bit-crush) — Throws away color depth (and optionally resolution), like a frame buffer with too few bits: smooth gradients turn into bands.
